checklist.note: Embedded OTDR A shows high reflection 3.52 dB at 0.004 km (near A-ODF), and B shows 3.53 dB at 24.749 km (near A-ODF from B side). Suggests bad connector at A-ODF.

checklist.item: Measure optical power at A-TX, B-ODF, B-RX
checklist.note: A-TX 1.09 dBm, B-ODF -8.29 dBm, B-RX -15.36 dBm. Link loss A-TX to B-ODF = 9.38 dB vs commissioning 5.95 dB, ~3.4 dB extra loss. Attenuator loss = 7.07 dB (expected 7 dB).

checklist.item: Run OTDR event table 1550 nm from A
checklist.note: 1550 OTDR from A confirms reflective loss 3.52 dB at -0.0 km (A-ODF connector), no other significant losses

checklist.item: Inspect connectors A-ODF, MID-PP, B-ODF
checklist.note: A-ODF end face shows multiple contamination spots and smudge, MID-PP and B-ODF clean

checklist.item: Identify root cause and submit diagnosis
checklist.note: Root cause identified as dirty A-ODF connector causing ~3.5 dB loss, consistent with patch work and measurements

args.evidence: Rx power dropped from ~-12.1 dBm to ~-15.36 dBm after 2026-10-18 patching at site A ODF; OTDR from A shows 3.52 dB reflective loss at -0.0 km at A-ODF, and embedded OTDR from B shows 3.53 dB at 24.749 km. Power measurements show A-TX 1.09 dBm, B-ODF -8.29 dBm giving link loss 9.38 dB vs commissioning 5.95 dB, ~3.4 dB extra loss. Inspection shows contamination on A-ODF end face; MID-PP and B-ODF clean.

evidence_refs.quote: Patching work at site A ODF
